measurement: Fresh video submissions, not physical scanout. Sequential live Virtual Display runs with changing content. First two phases were NOT gated against physical touch; user confirmed touching during them. Later comparisons gate remote forwarding while HID/DOM events remain active; injected motion fills absent physical contact. Physical contact counts include startup polls; per-stage profiling covers measurement only. These are not replay-identical A/B runs.
changes: Opt-in RAM scheduler/socket/media/touch profiling; requested/granted receive buffers and stage maxima.
High-refresh stereo negotiates 10 ms Opus packets through a pinned SDP build-copy adaptation; original RTSP audio quality preset, 20 ms native chunks, 40 ms prefill and bounded queue remain.

Pinned crypto build-copy adaptation retains keyed Mbed TLS GCM state for AES-128/12-byte nonce/16-byte tag; original replay policy and unsupported/CBC PSA fallbacks remain; cache destroyed/zeroized with each original context.
Persistent priority-cycle position prevents starvation across short cooperative slices; dispatch/send/audio remain first each cycle.
Retained large-table cached GCM, direct block-cipher dispatch and volatile zeroization with independent authentication/cleanup checks.
Synchronous borrowed compressed Opus input removes one native copy per packet.
Exact-signature/version/first-value guarded reads of owned movie Buffer metadata; unsupported ABI falls back to exports.
Removed unsuccessful 24 ms deadline loop and restored two presentation opportunities with consistent protocol work allowance.

runs.humanQualification: Invalid physical-input qualification: user reported the PC mouse did not move. The probe switched synthetic and physical primary IDs without a neutral sample, which can leave the gesture safety gate blocked.
User confirmed real touchscreen mouse and controller inputs work, and both still cause stalls. 180 s real-only run; no injected contacts or button suppression.

Rejected regression: user reported 15–40 rendered FPS and 7000+ frame gaps. The priority pass restarted on every short protocol slice, starving video. This candidate was replaced by the established rendering loop for the fair-scheduler trial.
User reported improved stalls; untouched rendering remained about 90 FPS. Audio counters still show substantial starvation.
User clarified that untouched rendering was 100–115 FPS; any touch/controller input caused a large drop.
User reported 80–90 FPS and touch-only stalls, with the previous build feeling better. Whole-run mean masks controller-active intervals at about 48–68 FPS; no smooth-input qualification.

User confirmed higher untouched FPS around 110 and reduced but still unpleasant touch/controller stalls. Per-second counters: idle 106.74 FPS (138.13 s), touch-active 89.25 FPS (20.34 s), controller-active 71.97 FPS (22.32 s). Input categories are sampled, not isolated replay-identical phases.

User confirmed lower FPS with no noticeable bad stalls during touch/controller input. Measured 91.42 FPS, maximum 72.94 ms and zero gaps above 100 ms in 119.49 s. Audio counters still show underruns; audible quality is recorded separately.
runs.audioQualification: Audible quality not yet confirmed; video/input smoothness was confirmed by user.

selectionReason: User explicitly preferred stable input over higher idle FPS, then confirmed no noticeable bad stalls in the final run.
